metric_evidence.quote: ACE-Trader outperforms direct prompting with the same DeepSeek V4 Flash backbone, increasing cumulative return from -19.72% to 12.44%.

evidence.quote: Testing covers 2026-01-01 to 202606-30, using prices, news, and associated asset information collected from Financial Modeling Prep

practical_problems.note: Test window set after the training-data cutoffs of all evaluated LLMs and feedback used only once observable; a leakage-controlled split rather than a leakage-versus-no-leakage comparison. calibration: post-cutoff test window used without a leaky-vs-clean contrast.

evidence.quote: Second, the Red-Team selector improves risk-adjusted performance. Variant 3 outperforms Variant 1 across all reported metrics.

practical_problems.note: Returns after 5 bp transaction costs under a gross-exposure limit; Sharpe, drawdown and volatility are reported and the Red-Team risk-review selector is ablated.

evidence.quote: First, how can Trader and Red-Team adapt memory selection to changing market conditions?

practical_problems.note: Return-trained selector is motivated by changing regimes; no regime-split or shift experiment is reported.

summary: ACE-Trader adds return-trained memory selection and a Trader-Red-Team review loop to an LLM portfolio trader; it beats the same backbone prompted directly and learned baselines after costs with lower drawdown, evaluated on a post-cutoff test period.
